statement: The ordinary-double-point volume gap. Proves the ordinary-double-point volume-gap conjecture: every singular complex algebraic klt germ of dimension n ≥ 2, with zero boundary, has normalized volume at most $`2(n-1)^n`$. Equality holds precisely for an analytic ordinary double point.
